name: POS Product Image Receipt

name: POS Product Category in Receipt
description: The Product Category in Receipt app for Odoo POS enhances receipts by automatically displaying each product’s category along with its details. This makes it easier for businesses and customers to quickly identify and organize purchased items.
summary: This app enhances the Point of Sale (POS) system by displaying the product category on the receipt. It automatically categorizes items purchased, making it easy for customers to identify the types of products they’ve bought. By adding a clear product category label, the receipt becomes more informative and organized, improving the overall customer experience. By categorizing items at the point of sale, the app not only helps customers easily identify their purchased products but also provides businesses with better record-keeping capabilities. The clear categorization of items improves the overall transaction experience, as receipts become more user-friendly and transparent. For businesses, this feature is essential for streamlining inventory management, tracking sales data by category, and improving overall customer service. This feature is especially useful for businesses with diverse inventories, offering clarity and better record-keeping. This app is designed to improve the functionality of a Point of Sale (POS) system by automatically displaying the product category on customer receipts. By categorizing items at the time of purchase, the app ensures that each receipt is organized and includes a clear label for the type of products bought. This feature is particularly beneficial for businesses that sell a wide range of items, from electronics and clothing to groceries and accessories, as it helps both customers and store staff easily identify product categories. name: POS Quick Payment
description: This module allows you to configure predefined payment amounts (e.g. 100, 200, 500) and link them to a specific journal. The buttons appear directly on the POS payment screen, enabling cashiers to register payments with a single click.
summary: This module introduces Quick Payment buttons in Odoo POS, allowing cashiers to process payments with a single click. Administrators can configure predefined amounts and link them to a specific Cash or Bank journal. The buttons appear directly on the POS payment screen, helping cashiers complete transactions faster, minimize errors, and improve the customer checkout experience.. The POS Quick Payment module enhances the Point of Sale system by introducing one-click payment buttons for predefined amounts. Instead of manually entering payment values, cashiers can simply tap a button (e.g. 5, 50, 100, 200) to instantly add that amount to the order. This feature is ideal for fast-moving retail, supermarkets, and restaurants, where speed and accuracy are critical. Quick payments reduce cashier errors, improve customer experience, and streamline the checkout process.
